segments.on_screen_text: 4 days in COLORADO ASPEN & VAIL
segments.description: Fast montage reel featuring highlighted moments from the trip to Aspen and Vail in Colorado.

segments.on_screen_text: A little getaway for the long weekend Going somewhere I've never been before
segments.description: View from an airplane window descending over runway and mountain landscape.

segments.on_screen_text: DAY 1 Perfect first meal after landing
segments.description: At an In-N-Out restaurant enjoying burgers and fries after landing.
Creator eating an In-N-Out burger directly facing the camera inside the restaurant.

segments.on_screen_text: A three and a half drive to aspen The view made it worth it
segments.description: Driving views along the highway towards Aspen with snow-capped mountain scenery.

segments.on_screen_text: FRENCH ALPINE BISTRO
segments.description: Outside and entrance view of the French Alpine Bistro in Aspen.

segments.on_screen_text: Made an early dinner res as soon as we arrived Fell in love with the cozy vibes immediately
segments.description: Inside the French Alpine Bistro, eating French onion soup, fondue, and enjoying drinks with friends.
Creator talking to camera while walking outside at night in Aspen after dinner.

segments.on_screen_text: Living Room AT HOTEL JEROME This place was packed
segments.description: Scenes at Living Room at Hotel Jerome enjoying cocktails and shots with friends.

segments.on_screen_text: KEMOSABE BE PREPARED TO SPEND
segments.description: Visiting Kemo Sabe hat and clothing store before heading to the Airbnb.

segments.on_screen_text: DAY 2
segments.description: Creator lying in bed at the Airbnb talking about plans for Day 2.
Stepping out onto the snowy balcony, enjoying morning views in Aspen.
Get ready with me style outfit breakdown in the bedroom showing winter layers and accessories.
Drive-by snowy landscapes and mountains around Aspen.

segments.on_screen_text: WHITE HOUSE TAVERN
segments.description: Eating lunch at White House Tavern, showing chicken sandwich, kale salad, and french dip.

segments.on_screen_text: This was one of my favorite meals The Sandwich was so good!!
segments.description: Creator eating sandwich directly in front of camera inside White House Tavern.
Walking on snow outside after lunch.
Walking in the snow talking to camera about heading to Little Nell for hot chocolate.
Views of Aspen streets, ski slopes in the background, walking around town.
Trying on faux fur coats and hood in store looking into mirror camera.

segments.on_screen_text: Came back to Kemo Sabe Loved this coat and came back to try it on
segments.description: Shops in Kemo Sabe trying on custom cowboy hats and coats.

segments.on_screen_text: Warming up at the Little Nell got their famous hot chocolate
segments.description: Close-up of famous Little Nell hot chocolate with whipped cream and chocolate shavings.

segments.on_screen_text: 6/10 a bit overpriced but a nice little break for the day
segments.description: Drinking the Little Nell hot chocolate indoors and reviewing it.

segments.on_screen_text: Met up with our friends who finished snowboarding CASA TUA Early dinner at Casa Tua before driving to Vail
segments.description: Apres ski drinks outside and early dinner with friends at Casa Tua.

segments.on_screen_text: DAY 3 Fiancé braided my hair hehe
segments.description: Creator showing braided hairstyle done by fiancé.

segments.on_screen_text: Picking up our ski rentals
segments.description: Fitting ski boots and picking up ski rental gear.
Creator walking in ski gear talking to camera before first ski lesson in Vail.

segments.on_screen_text: After a full day of skiing joined some other friends for dinner Every night we ended with an intense couple rounds of monopoly deal :) Late night shin ramyun
segments.description: Skiing on slopes, chairlift rides, evening dinner, Monopoly Deal game, and cooking Shin Ramyun.

segments.on_screen_text: DAY 4
segments.description: Day 4 makeup and layering clothes routine facing camera.

segments.on_screen_text: THE LITTLE DINER
segments.description: Breakfast at The Little Diner in Vail, showing burrito and hash dish.

segments.on_screen_text: Attempting to ski with my friends today Second day of skiing feeling a bit more confident
segments.description: Gondola ride and second day of skiing on Vail mountain with friends.

segments.on_screen_text: Walking over to meet up with my friends First ever ski shot I was scared lol
segments.description: Walking to bar and doing a 4-person ski shot at The Red Lion.

segments.on_screen_text: Thank you for watching!
segments.description: Plater of chicken wings at restaurant with friends reaching in.

segments.on_screen_text: Follow me on Instagram @Loisjyou
segments.description: Outro screen with Instagram call to action.

hook.opening_visual: Montage opening showing mountain scenery and creator posing on balcony in Aspen.
hook.notes: A fast aesthetic montage previewing key moments of the 4-day trip to Aspen and Vail.
